task:
Without a receipt, send the claim for review regardless of age or defect. With a receipt, refund defective goods through day 30 inclusive and nondefective goods through day 14 inclusive. Deny other claims.
Requested change: Extend only the defective-goods deadline to day 45 inclusive. Preserve all other rules.
Contract: facts: days (nonnegative integer), defective (boolean), receipt (boolean). decision: status (review, refund, or deny).

The base delivery fee is 0 at a subtotal of 100 or more, otherwise 5. Express delivery always adds 10, including when the base fee is 0.
Requested change: Raise the free base-delivery threshold to 120 inclusive. Preserve the express surcharge.
Contract: facts: subtotal (nonnegative integer), express (boolean). decision: fee (integer).

Send an expense report for review if a reimbursable line exceeds its limit. Otherwise approve it. Independently, total only reimbursable lines at or below the limit. This total is still reported when the status is review.
Requested change: Send the report for review if any line exceeds the limit, even if that line is not reimbursable. Preserve the total calculation.
Contract: facts: limit (nonnegative integer), lines (ordered list of amount: nonnegative integer and reimbursable: boolean). decision: status (approved or review), total (integer).

Reserve the requested quantity if enough stock is available; otherwise reserve nothing. Remaining stock is starting stock minus the amount reserved.
Requested change: Allow partial fulfillment: reserve all available stock when stock is insufficient. Keep remaining stock equal to starting stock minus the amount actually reserved.
Contract: facts: stock and requested (nonnegative integers). decision: reserved and remaining (integers).

Change the allocation policy so that, when the sum of eligible weights is zero, every eligible recipient has effective weight one. Ineligible recipients still have effective weight zero, regardless of their supplied weight. This fallback also applies to a zero total, so eligible zero-weight rows participate and expose the corresponding metadata. If any eligible weight is positive, retain the existing weights, including zero-weight nonparticipants. Negative weights remain invalid even for ineligible recipients. A positive total with no eligible recipients remains rejected; zero total with no eligible recipients succeeds. Preserve whole-cent/nonnegative budget checks, exact arithmetic, largest-remainder selection, at most one extra cent per participating row, input-order ties, and the existing request/output shape and row order. Duplicate labels are not keys. Compute participates, amount, remainder_score, and received_extra_cent using effective weights; keep labels and canonical decimal strings unchanged. Remainder score is total times effective weight minus base amount times total effective weight, before extra cents. Preserve every behavior unaffected by this change.
